blocks.source: 张巍GRE填空机经2000题 · Test 16 Section 2
blocks.noteTail: （原题及配套答案，仅供个人学习；暂不附讲解）

stem: The theory that the 1908 Tunguska event was the explosion of a cosmic body in the sky over Siberia is ____: no one has yet found fragments of the object or any impact craters in the affected region.
Motivation is the hardest of all managerial tasks, and it is ____ to expect a single memo, no matter how well crafted, to have much effect on the staff’s attitude.

Collecting such fragment of contemporary popular culture as postcards, newspaper clippings, and wallpaper patterns, Susan Hiller transforms these seemingly (i)____ artifacts into objective (ii)____ by making them the centerpieces in her compositions.

In adolescence, (i)____ interactions are crucial in forging a self-identity. To be sure, this process often plays out in (ii)____ as a means of defining and shoring up the sense of self. Kids will seek out like-minded companions, and spurn others who seem different. But when kept within reasonable bounds, this in-group (iii)____ generally evolves into a more mature friendship pattern.
colsZh: 同等地位的人，同辈；好奇地凝视
结成小圈子的社交行为

stem: The concept of the Hellenistic period in ancient history has proved useful but also ____, with scholars disagreeing on the dates when the period began and ended.
optsZh: 引人入胜的；有说服力的

stem: Few ideas are more ____ than the notion that cultures evolve in Darwin fashion; many academics have begun writing about cultural evolution, but few treat the underlying Darwinian logic with the care it deserves.
optsZh: 引起争议的，引起分裂的

stem: After many years of feeling ____ by his seniors managers, Clark was becoming hopeful of advancement.
optsZh: 感到委屈或愤愤不平的
